history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - this is a Roman Catholic church; keep-or-drop decision needed. IDENTITY NOTE: the CSV name 'Catholic Church Senapati' is generic and no source names a parish church inside Senapati town itself; this record is provisionally mapped to St. John Bosco Parish Church at Maram Khunou, Senapati district - the best-documented Catholic church in the district. It hosted the December 8, 2023 episcopal ordination/installation of Archbishop Linus Neli as the fifth Archbishop of Imphal (over 10,000 Catholics attended, with 4 archbishops and 14 bishops, per the Diocese of Kohima and LiCAS reports), and the first-ever Manipur Eucharistic Convention of the Manipur Catholic Youth Organisation in December 2025 (700+ youth from across the archdiocese, per RVA). Catholics in Senapati district belong to the Archdiocese of Imphal (erected as a diocese in 1980, raised to archdiocese in 1995; territory = all of Manipur). Most Rev. Linus Neli was born April 26, 1958 at Punanamei village, Senapati district, ordained priest December 20, 1984, elected Archbishop October 7, 2023 and consecrated December 8, 2023 (Diocese of Kohima). Another documented Senapati-district parish is St. Joseph's Parish, Tadubi, which runs a higher secondary school (Indian Catholic Matters). If the dataset owner has a different Senapati parish in mind, the name should be corrected. Coordinates are geocoded to the Don Bosco/Maram Khunou area - the exact church location is unverified. No reliable photo of this church was found (media empty).

town_description: Senapati is the district headquarters town of Senapati district, about 60-70 km north of Imphal on NH-2, in the Mao-Naga hill country. The district is overwhelmingly Christian (Naga tribes); Catholic parishes under the Archdiocese of Imphal serve the community alongside Baptist and other churches. Maram Khunou, where St. John Bosco Parish Church stands, is a short drive from Senapati town.
